datasets.name: ds_endpoints
queryLines:
SELECT project_id, branch_id, endpoint_id, endpoint_type, last_state, last_rollup_ts, last_snapshot_ts,
  round((unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(last_snapshot_ts)) / 3600.0, 1) AS hours_since_snapshot,
  CASE WHEN last_skipped_ts >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS skipped_14d
FROM lb_health_endpoints

datasets.name: ds_coverage
queryLines:
SELECT project_id, branch_id, endpoint_id, endpoint_type, day, rollup_runs, snapshot_ok_runs, snapshot_failed_runs,
  snapshot_skipped_runs, last_snapshot_ts, hours_with_telemetry, hours_without_telemetry,
  CASE WHEN rollup_runs = 0 THEN 'no rollup run (job failure?)'
       WHEN hours_without_telemetry > 0 THEN 'telemetry gap'
       ELSE 'ok' END AS coverage_status
FROM lb_health_coverage
WHERE day >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)
ORDER BY day DESC, project_id, branch_id, endpoint_id

datasets.name: ds_trend_t1
queryLines:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT day, project_id, branch_id, endpoint_id, t1_conn_util_busiest_hour AS value
  FROM lb_health_daily WHERE t1_conn_util_busiest_hour IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT day, project_id, branch_id, endpoint_id, 'Actual (' || endpoint_id || ')' AS series, value FROM d
UNION ALL
SELECT d.day, d.project_id, d.branch_id, d.endpoint_id, 'Reference' AS series,
  CASE t.reference_type
    WHEN 'static' THEN t.value
    WHEN 'any_above_zero' THEN 0.0
    WHEN 'prior_period_avg' THEN avg(d.value) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.project_id, d.branch_id, d.endpoint_id ORDER BY unix_date(d.day)
      RANGE BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
  END AS value
FROM d CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM lb_health_thresholds WHERE threshold_id = 'T1') t

datasets.name: ds_bloat_top
queryLines:
SELECT project_id, branch_id, endpoint_id, datname, object_type, object_name, table_name, bloat_pct, bloat_bytes,
  real_size, bloat_is_na, bloat_ts
FROM lb_health_objects_latest
WHERE bloat_bytes IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(bloat_is_na, 0) = 0
ORDER BY bloat_bytes DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_large_tables
queryLines:
SELECT o.project_id, o.branch_id, o.endpoint_id, o.datname, o.object_name, o.n_live_tup, o.n_dead_tup,
  o.n_dead_tup / nullif(o.n_live_tup + o.n_dead_tup, 0) AS dead_ratio,
  o.hours_since_autovacuum, o.last_autovacuum, o.seq_scan_7d, o.snapshot_ts
FROM lb_health_objects_latest o
CROSS JOIN (SELECT value AS min_rows FROM lb_health_thresholds WHERE threshold_id = 'cfg_large_table_min_rows') c
WHERE o.object_type = 'table' AND o.n_live_tup >= c.min_rows
ORDER BY o.n_dead_tup DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_seq_scan_queries
queryLines:
SELECT project_id, branch_id, endpoint_id, datname, queryid, left(max_by(query_text, day), 160) AS query_text,
  array_join(array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(relations))), ', ') AS relations,
  sum(scan_count) AS scan_count, avg(avg_duration_ms) AS avg_duration_ms,
  max(CASE WHEN is_new THEN day END) AS new_on, min(day) AS first_day, max(day) AS last_day
FROM lb_health_seq_scan_queries
WHERE day >= date_sub(current_date(), 14)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY scan_count DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_idx_invalid
queryLines:
SELECT project_id, branch_id, endpoint_id, datname, finding, object_name, table_name, index_bytes,
  CASE WHEN length(indexdef) > 140 THEN left(indexdef, 137) || '...' ELSE indexdef END AS indexdef,
  array_join(duplicate_of, ', ') AS duplicate_of, observed_days, day
FROM lb_health_index_findings
WHERE finding = 'invalid' AND day = (SELECT max(day) FROM lb_health_index_findings)
ORDER BY index_bytes DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_idx_unused
queryLines:

  CASE WHEN length(indexdef) > 140 THEN left(indexdef, 137) || '...' ELSE indexdef END AS indexdef,
  array_join(duplicate_of, ', ') AS duplicate_of, observed_days, day
FROM lb_health_index_findings
WHERE finding IN ('unused', 'unused_candidate') AND day = (SELECT max(day) FROM lb_health_index_findings)
ORDER BY index_bytes DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_idx_duplicate
queryLines:
SELECT project_id, branch_id, endpoint_id, datname, finding, object_name, table_name, index_bytes,
  CASE WHEN length(indexdef) > 140 THEN left(indexdef, 137) || '...' ELSE indexdef END AS indexdef,
  array_join(duplicate_of, ', ') AS duplicate_of, observed_days, day
FROM lb_health_index_findings
WHERE finding = 'duplicate' AND day = (SELECT max(day) FROM lb_health_index_findings)
ORDER BY index_bytes DESC
LIMIT 10

lines: Status of each trend over the review period (yesterday back N days, UTC) compared with the prior period of equal length. 🔴 red = latest day breaches its reference line · 🟠 amber = breached earlier in the period · 🟢 green = no breach · ℹ️ info = no reference line.

frame.title: Trend status by endpoint
frame.description: Each trend is shown in its own unit (percent, count or ratio). Change the period with the Review period filter.

lines: Each chart plots the actual daily value (one line per endpoint) against its reference line from lb_health_thresholds (orange). Use the Endpoint filter to look at one endpoint at a time.

frame.title: Connection utilization (busiest hour)
frame.description: Connection utilization (busiest hour p95). Orange = reference line (default 70%); other colours = actual value per endpoint.

frame.title: Long idle-in-transaction sessions
frame.description: Idle-in-transaction sessions > 60 s. Orange = reference line (default any above 0); other colours = actual value per endpoint.

frame.title: Idle-in-transaction time share
frame.description: Idle-in-transaction share of session time. Orange = reference line (default 10%); other colours = actual value per endpoint.

frame.title: CPU utilization (busiest hour)
frame.description: CPU utilization (busiest hour p95). Orange = reference line (default 70%); other colours = actual value per endpoint.

frame.title: CPU per connection
frame.description: CPU per connection. Orange = reference line (default prior 14-day average); other colours = actual value per endpoint.

frame.title: Cache hit rate
frame.description: Cache hit rate (shared buffers + local file cache). Orange = reference line (default below 99%); other colours = actual value per endpoint.

frame.title: Working set vs. cache size
frame.description: Working set / cache size. Orange = reference line (default 80%); other colours = actual value per endpoint.

frame.title: Table and index bloat
frame.description: Max bloat % (objects ≥ 100 MB wasted). Orange = reference line (default 30%); other colours = actual value per endpoint.

frame.title: Dead rows on large tables
frame.description: Dead rows on large tables. No reference line; watch for steady growth.

frame.title: Full scans of large tables
frame.description: Full-scan equivalents per day (large tables). Orange = reference line (default 10 per day); other colours = actual value per endpoint.

frame.title: New sequential-scan queries
frame.description: New seq-scan queries on large tables. Orange = reference line (default any above 0); other colours = actual value per endpoint.

lines: Days without a point had no telemetry (endpoint suspended) or no snapshot. Thresholds are edited in `lb_health_thresholds` and apply retroactively.

Long idle-in-transaction sessions and new sequential-scan queries breach on any value above 0 (their reference line is 0); cache hit rate breaches when *below* its line. A trend with a single day of data shows as one point.

lines: Telemetry gap = the rollup ran but some hours have no system.lakebase rows · No rollup run = the job did not run that day · Skipped = the endpoint was not running and was not woken.
